mapper.sql: a.id, a.schedule_date, a.cx_batch_no, a.batch_no, a.order_no, a.sidewall_code, a.glue_code, a.glue_seq, a.mouth_plate_code, a.unit_consume, a.machine_id, a.stock_qty, a.supply_time, a.day_plan_qty, a.day_produce_order, a.day_sys_analysis, a.day_hand_analysis, a.night_plan_qty, a.night_produce_order, a.night_sys_analysis, a.night_hand_analysis, a.pre_plan_qty, a.cx_class1_plan, a.cx_class2_plan, a.cx_class3_plan, a.cx_class4_plan, a.cx_class5_plan,IS_RELEASE, a.remark, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time,a.PRODUCTION_STATUS,a.mark_close_out_tip,a.data_source,
mapper.select:
select * from ( select
(NVL(day_plan_qty, 0) + NVL(night_plan_qty, 0)) as daily_total_qty, b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as month_plan, ceil(b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) as month_plan_os from t_tc_assist_schedule a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY FROM T_TC_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS WHERE del_flag='0' and YEAR=#{year,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) b on a.sidewall_code=b.MATERIAL_CODE where a.del_flag='0' and a.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate ,jdbcType=DATE} and instr(a.sidewall_code, #{sidewallCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(a.glue_code , #{glueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and instr(a.mouth_plate_code , #{mouthPlateCode})>0
and instr(','||a.machine_id||',', ','||#{machineId}||',')>0
order by (case when instr(machine_id,',') > 0 then machine_id when machine_id is null or machine_id = '' then '0' else '-1' end) desc/*多个机台 和 没有机台的排在前面*/, to_number(substr(a.glue_seq,0,instr(a.glue_seq,'.')-1)), to_number(substr(a.glue_seq,instr(a.glue_seq,'.')+1)) asc ) t
order by ${orderStr}
